label: Commission setter - local website agency
pricing: the agency builds the site for a one-time fee and it's live in a week - they'll go over exact numbers on the call
opener: Hey, is this {owner}? This is {me} - you guys are {business} in {city}, right? Quick question.
question: When someone in {city} Googles you, what do they land on right now?
value: You've got {reviews} reviews - people clearly like you - but with no website a lot of those searchers go to whoever has one. The team I work with builds trades sites that turn those searches into calls, live in about a week.
ask: Can I get you 15 minutes with them Thursday or Friday? They'll show you what it'd look like before you spend anything.

objections.word_of_mouth_is_enough: That's how you got {reviews} reviews - awesome. The site just catches the people who hear your name and look you up before they call.
